The Journey

Thirty Years.
One Passion.

A timeline for the milestones, acquisitions, restorations and memorable events that shaped Duraimohan Classics.

1996

The Beginning

The first classic enters the garage and begins a lifelong journey into automotive preservation.

2000

First Major Show

The collection begins participating in organised classic-car events.

2005

The Collection Grows

More significant automobiles join the collection.

2010

National Recognition

Classic-car participation expands and the collection earns wider recognition.

2015

30+ Shows

Years of participation turn the collection into a familiar name among enthusiasts.

2020 — 2026

Preserving the Legacy

20+ classics, 50+ shows and an archive that continues to grow.
